decision: Run the capstone Directive proof on pinned Node.js 24.20.0 while keeping the fictional application Node.js 20-compatible

governingRule.description: Observed behavior from the exact learner pin outranks prose, and pre-release compatibility shims are forbidden

alternativesConsidered.option: Keep Node.js 20.20.2 and shim node:fs globSync
Change the exact Directive 0.112.0 learner pin

whyWinner: Directive 0.112.0 imports fs.globSync, which is unavailable before Node.js 22; Node.js 24.20.0 is already the repository's pinned native consumer proof and preserves the Node.js 20-compatible application surface without a shim or pin change
revisitTrigger: Revisit when the learner Directive pin both declares and passes a different supported Node.js runtime
